notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.25
notes.content:
Added armored kit for buses

Added custom call signs for players and units

Opened system settings, can adjust volume and filters

Fixed logistics units staying idle issue

Fixed player units receiving reinforcements in enemy FOB issue

Optimized unit voice playback logic

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.22
notes.content:
The "Repair & Modification" feature is now live!

Added a new vehicle type — Bus.

Fixed an issue where items were erroneously duplicated during modification.

Fixed several errors caused by casualties dying before treatment was completed.

Fixed an issue where vehicles were teleported to inaccessible parking spots after repair.

Fixed incorrect building rendering effects.

Added vehicle volume compensation for hit accuracy

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.19
notes.content:
Fixed an error where wounded soldiers were cloned during transport

Fixed an issue where saving and exiting during weapon reloading caused the reload state to not end

Added a feature where wounded soldiers dropped within the FOB area are gathered at the FOB center

Added a feature where the front line is hidden when the camera zooms in

Fixed some logical errors with routing enemies

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.16
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where vehicles would still refresh even when the parking area was blocked

Fixed an issue where parking point data was lost after loading

Fixed an issue where explosion shockwaves did not damage scene decorations

Fixed an issue where forced attack indicators failed to load properly after loading

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.15
notes.content:
Fixed an error where manual commands could sometimes cause movement to stop

Added a mechanism where higher buildings allow observation of more building information

Fixed a crash caused by repeated interactions between vehicles

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.14
notes.content:
Added armament parking points; vehicles returning to the FOB will now park here

Added two-person transport squad

Adjusted the composition of the medical team

Fixed some errors causing logistics teams not to work

Optimized pathfinding so that units returning to FOB will prioritize parking vehicles in the lot

Fixed an error with parking point data when loading

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.11
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where logistics teams repeatedly searched the same area

Fixed an issue where unloading failed under certain conditions

Fixed an issue where move commands caused errors under certain conditions

Hid some enemy UI elements that should not be displayed

Fixed display errors in some UI icons

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.08&09.09
notes.content:
Fixed some causes where commands were not executed

Fixed crash caused by incorrect vehicle evacuation

Fixed issue where transport teams did not fully unload

Optimized logistics transport logic

Fixed incorrect value display in unit item inventory

Optimized abandoned vehicle generation so they remain permanently fixed on the map

Fixed various issues with wounded interactions

Added prompt when warehouse is full

Fixed incorrect hit calculation during bombardment

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.07
notes.content:
Fixed an invalid repair of vehicle parts caused by floating point issues

Fixed some issues that caused route drawing to fail

Fixed an issue where storage entries were displayed incorrectly

Added a feature to hide facility work teams

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.06
notes.content:
Optimized the frontline advancement logic

Fixed an issue where logistics teams could not recover airdropped supplies

Fixed a data error caused by allowing units to embark/disembark while moving

Fixed an issue where some tooltips would not disappear

Fixed an issue where white noise would not play

Fixed several medical-related issues

Fixed an issue where victory notifications were displayed incorrectly

Added an indicator to show suppression fire target points

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.05
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where killing enemies with heavy weapons did not grant experience

Fixed an issue where medevac data was lost after loading

Fixed an issue where enemy FOBs would still respawn after losing all defenders

Fixed an issue where some warnings were repeatedly displayed

Fixed an issue where item count would display negative after picking up items

Fixed an issue where duplicate crew members appeared inside vehicles

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.04
notes.content:
Fixed a crash caused by the Encyclopedia Assistant when returning to the main menu and re-entering the game

Fixed some text configuration errors

Fixed an error in displaying the number of wounded

Fixed a UI error after medical reinforcements

Fixed an issue where some building effects were lost when loading

Fixed an issue where unit unloading quantities were incorrect

Fixed an issue where units could not properly replenish rations

Fixed an issue where enemy FOBs would automatically reinforce during combat

Fixed a save failure issue caused by casualties occurring during saving

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.03
notes.content:
Added an Encyclopedia Helper that shows related encyclopedia entries for the current interaction object

Fixed an error where saved game duration was not displayed correctly

Fixed an error where facilities could not be constructed even when manpower was sufficient

Fixed an error where manpower consumption was incorrect during reinforcement

Optimized some encyclopedia text

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.02
notes.content:
Fixed an error when infantry dropped items on vehicles

Fixed an issue where units froze before pathfinding results were returned

Added a toggle to allow or prevent logistics squads from crossing the frontline on their own

Fixed an issue where units did not respond to orders under certain conditions

Optimized the pathfinding logic for logistics squads when returning

Blocked the interaction where players incorrectly connected intact vehicles to damaged ones

Fixed some errors caused by click exploits

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.01
notes.content:
Changed fonts and some UI styles to improve readability

Fixed an issue where some text in the command menu could not be aligned

Added a limit to the maximum number of collection zones to prevent crashes caused by setting too many at once

Revised part of the tutorial content to make it smoother

Fixed a crash caused by a pathfinding error

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.08.31
notes.content:
Fixed the issue where transport teams could not unload when roads were congested.

Added the ability to select collection areas via box selection.

Fixed some UI display issues when creating a new FOB.

Fixed the crash when work teams boarded vehicles.

Fixed the error caused by repeatedly boarding vehicles.

Fixed the issue where work teams could not add or remove members after loading a save.

Fixed the issue where units continued to retreat even after leaving combat.

Fixed the incorrect calculation of repair kit usage.

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.08.30
notes.content:
New Unit: Pickup Truck (82mm Mortar), along with the artillery adjustment mechanism. Now, when a player-controlled unit conducts bombardment, it will continuously adjust to reduce the dispersion of impact points.

Fixed some errors during item transportation.

Fixed an issue where some weapon barrels had excessively low durability.

Fixed errors caused by not following the tutorial instructions.

Fixed a crash when entering a vehicle after repair completion upon loading.

Fixed an issue with event time calculation.

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.08.29
notes.content:
New Mechanic: Units with obstructed vision can roughly guess the enemy’s position based on activity traces and noises.

Reduced the number of enemy troops in some attacks.

Fixed an issue where the last member of an infantry squad would not die.

Fixed a bug where linked information of vehicles being boarded was lost after loading.

Optimized some causes of stuttering during battles.

Fixed some errors related to enemy traces when loading.

Changed the squad badge marker for work groups.

Added a shortcut button to quickly create a new squad.

Fixed an issue that could cause load errors.

Added some new sound effects.

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.08.28
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where vehicles were in the wrong position after loading

Fixed an issue where evacuated vehicles still appeared in the list

Added a new stewed meat recipe in the canteen

Fixed an issue where medical data was partially lost after loading

Restricted the minimum efficiency of facility operations

Fixed an issue where reinforcements were not replenished outside the initial base

Fixed a text display error after enemy forces occupied buildings

Fixed an issue where vehicle data was reset after crew disembarked

Fixed an issue where crew could not interact after dying inside a vehicle

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.08.27
notes.content:
Fixed the conflict issue between crew and vehicle inventory.

Fixed the issue where repeatedly clicking within FOB range caused buildable areas to remain on the map.

Fixed a crash issue when ordering new equipment.

Modified the description text of certain facilities.

Optimized the performance of certain pathfinding.

Fixed some errors in camera movement.

Fixed issues that could cause save errors.

Fixed incorrect UI position above units.

Fixed construction loss error after picking up a vehicle.

Fixed the random event algorithm error.

Fixed an error when loading vehicles sent back for repair.

Fixed the issue where enemy data appeared in logistics settings.

Fixed ghost vehicles blocking roads.

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.08.26
notes.content:
Modified some tutorial text

Fixed some text configuration errors

Adjusted text background style

Fixed some pathfinding errors

Fixed crash issue when eating at outpost

Fixed the crash when FOB was dismantled.

Disabled the FOB deletion feature in the tutorial.

Fixed the crash caused by writing off-map artillery targets to the save.

Fixed possible camera position errors when loading.

Limited the maximum duration of enemy artillery preparation.

Fixed crashes when repairing vehicles.

Adjusted weapon barrel wear values during firing.

Fixed the issue where no parking spot was found when ordering new equipment.

Fixed residual data not cleared after interrupting transport squad work.

Fixed crashes caused by repeatedly switching states during transport squad work.

Fixed navigation errors caused by unknown reasons.
